description: Asks to change the app's GitHub settings, the switches on its GitHub card in Ploa: labelBuilds (a PR label ploa:android, ploa:ios or ploa:all builds the PR's head), iosHosted (iOS builds on GitHub's Macs instead of the person's own Mac; the signing identity goes to GitHub's machine for the build, and a Mac minute counts as ten of the person's GitHub minutes on a private repository: say so first), releaseFlow (Releases on GitHub: deployments, a tag and a GitHub Release when a version goes live, the next version's PR), storeCode (the store page from the repo's store/ folder becomes drafts on push) and issues (GitHub issues from the stores per source: rejections, reviews, crashes, feedback). Give only what should change. The app must be linked to its repository first (ploa_github_setup). The settings are the person's: a person approves the change on ploa.dev, and iOS on GitHub's Macs only an owner (an autonomous agent's change goes through at once, but never iosHosted, which an owner turns on the card). Pass the person the link and follow it with ploa_approval_status. Already as asked: nothing is asked.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

iosHosted.description: iOS builds on GitHub's Macs (true) or the person's own Mac as a self-hosted runner (false). An owner's decision.

issues.description: GitHub issues from the stores, per source.

crashes.description: An issue while Google Play's crash or ANR rate is over its bad-behavior threshold.

feedback.description: One issue a day with TestFlight testers' feedback.

rejections.description: An issue per App Review or Play rejection, closed once approved.

reviews.description: One issue a day per store with the new one- and two-star reviews.

labelBuilds.description: Builds from PR labels (ploa:android, ploa:ios, ploa:all).

releaseFlow.description: Releases on GitHub: deployments, a tag and a GitHub Release when a version goes live, the next version's PR.

storeCode.description: The store page from the repo's store/ folder: a push to the release branch makes drafts.

name: ploa_github_settings
title: Change the app's GitHub settings
